bio.oneLine: Brandon Bande is a Zimbabwean Business Analyst, AI builder and technology advocate working across business systems, digital transformation and emerging technologies.
professional: Brandon T. Bande is a Zimbabwean Business Analyst, AI builder and technology advocate working at the intersection of business systems, emerging technologies and digital transformation.

He holds a degree in Telecommunications Engineering and works as a Business Analyst at Midlands State University, where his work involves understanding institutional processes, documenting requirements, supporting business process re-engineering and contributing to the development of digital systems.

Beyond his professional work, Brandon has been active in technology communities since 2020. He has contributed to developer advocacy and community building through initiatives including Google Developer Groups Harare, Zindi and the Young AI Leaders Hub Gweru, which he leads under the ITU AI for Good initiative.

His interests include AI agents, open-weight language models, edge AI, data sovereignty and African language technology. Through independent projects, speaking engagements and community initiatives, he explores how emerging technologies can address practical challenges and create meaningful opportunities.
His guiding belief is that Africa's future in AI must be shaped by Africans.
